idea.name: Lanco trailer rentals
idea.one_liner: Rent trailers to local consumers and businesses by the day, with online booking and contactless pickup.
idea.customer: People and local businesses that need trailers for moving, hauling, landscaping, junk removal, or vehicle transport.
idea.offer: A range of open and enclosed trailers, including dump trailers, rented from a self-service lot.
idea.revenue_model: Per-day trailer rental fees; security deposits cover damage.

idea.name: Trailer rental arbitrage as a demand test
idea.one_liner: List a trailer for rent on rental platforms, then source it from another owner when booked to test demand before buying a trailer.
idea.customer: People looking for a short-term box trailer rental.
idea.offer: Arrange access to a third-party trailer and coordinate pickup and drop-off; the host presents it as a low-cost demand test, not a proven standalone business.
idea.revenue_model: List at the going rental price and source the trailer for a similar rate; the host says it may break even or lose money while validating demand.
